vb_textbox.text: I enjoyed this experiment playing this game, it was certainly interesting and unique. My strategy for this game was to partly use my button mashing speed to try and earn the most points I could achieve. Sometimes I wasn't entirely accurate with the button mashing while other time it paid of earning a high number of points. I enjoy these types of studies as I am a gamer, I love playing video games it's one of my favorite hobbies so I am glad to to participate.
